title: Read the corresponding data according to the field name
goal: Use square brackets to read object properties by the name provided by the variable.
summary: The record panel decides which fields to display at runtime. Field names may contain hyphens.
tasks: completes readField(record, field). Reads its own properties in record by the key specified by field.
field is missing. Keep the existing values ​​0, false, and the empty string.

example.note: What is written after the dot is the fixed attribute name, and variables or expressions can be used in square brackets.

hint: You can call Object.hasOwn(record, field) first to ensure that you are searching for the record's own attributes.
